citation_counts.limitations: Counts refer to the returned exact-title records; conference and arXiv versions can be split. New 2026 records have indexing lag. This is not a global most-cited ranking and does not rank model accuracy. Semantic Scholar separately returned HTTP 429.

candidates.role: SOMA hand reconstruction with DINOv3 and optional tracking
candidates.configuration: DINOv3-H+ + MHR-identity SOMA, perspective crops, bounded tracking and official adaptive temporal smoothing

candidates.caveat: Official release exposes inference on precomputed benchmark caches; data preprocessing is still marked TODO. Never substitute fabricated VGGT scene/visual features.
candidates.reason: The public release has benchmark-cache inference but no custom-video preprocessing. Current RGB videos cannot supply its required scene and quality features without an additional unpublished preprocessing pipeline.

candidates.caveat: Requires separately gated SAM 3D Body/MHR assets. Model-specific results use different protocols and cannot establish a global ranking.
